752:		return
753:	end

779:local function onZoneChanged(zoneId, on)
780:	if on or not active or hidden or capture or shush or finale then return end
781:	if now() < nextHopAt or state == "Stunned" then return end
782:	-- a zone just went dark near its target (or any player): appear in it
783:	local r = target and select(3, bodyOf(target))
784:	if not r then return end
785:	local zoneCandidates = {}
786:	local positions = playerPositions()
787:	for i, n in ipairs(nodes) do
788:		if n.Zone == zoneId and nodeDark(i) then
789:			local pd = minDistance(n.Pos, positions)
790:			if pd >= BLINK_HOP_MIN_DISTANCE and (n.Pos - r.Position).Magnitude <= 40 then
791:				zoneCandidates[#zoneCandidates + 1] = i
792:			end
793:		end
794:	end
795:	if #zoneCandidates > 0 and math.random() < 0.6 then
796:		hopTo(zoneCandidates[math.random(1, #zoneCandidates)], "blink", BLINK_HOP_MIN_DISTANCE)
797:	end

800:-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- player noise intake
801:-- NoiseReporter fires Remotes.ReportNoise ("walk"/"sprint") at 5 Hz on levels 1, 2 and 4. EntityAI is disabled in
802:-- this round, so the Usher drains it. Module scope, once (like Pool Foam's intake): a session-scoped connection
803:-- would leave the remote undrained whenever Start bailed. The server decides position and plausibility.
804:do
805:	local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
806:	local report = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("ReportNoise")
807:	if report and report:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
808:		local lastReport = {}
809:		report.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, stateName)
810:			if not active or not objectives or (stateName ~= "walk" and stateName ~= "sprint") then return end
811:			if workspace:GetAttribute("SelectedLevel") ~= Configuration.Level then return end
812:			local t = os.clock()
813:			if (lastReport[player] or 0) > t then return end
814:			lastReport[player] = t + 0.15
815:			if player:GetAttribute("InRound") ~= true or player:GetAttribute("Escaped") == true then return end
816:			local _, _, r = bodyOf(player)
817:			if not r or r.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude < 2 or objectives.IsHidden(player) then return end
818:			NoiseRegistry.Add(r.Position, stateName, player)
819:		end)
820:		Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) lastReport[player] = nil end)
821:	end
822:end
